definition.en: A grouping used to study places together.
definition.zh: 为一起研究地方而使用的分组。

definition.en: A group of islands, not an organisation’s member list.
definition.zh: 一组岛屿，不是组织成员名单。

definition.en: A narrow sea passage between land areas.
definition.zh: 陆地之间较窄的海上通道。

definition.en: Calendar-month statistics over a stated multi-year period.
definition.zh: 指定多年时期中按月份统计的资料。

definition.en: A seasonally changing large-scale atmospheric circulation.
definition.zh: 随季节改变的大范围大气环流。

definition.en: Coastal plant communities such as those at Sungei Buloh.
definition.zh: 如双溪布洛所见的海岸植物群落。

definition.en: A retained field made along a slope.
definition.zh: 沿坡修成、有挡护的田面。

definition.en: An organisation of neighbouring states whose members joined on different dates.
definition.zh: 成员按不同日期加入的区域国家组织。

definition.en: Working together on shared matters, such as conservation.
definition.zh: 在共同事务上携手行动，如保育。
